_comment: Class Progression (design doc v3): each class here gets a hard FORK at 'fork_level' into two lanes; classes absent from this file simply level along their base tables. Each lane: 'name' + 'archetype' (the name shown from capstone level on), 'blurb' (shown on the choice card), 'offsets' (permanent adds to the class table: hit = to-hit AND damage, ac = armor class), 'passive' (always-on, from the passive list below), 'verb' (the signature action gained at its 'level'), 'capstone' (gained at its 'level'; numbers tunable), 'refinement' (upgrades the verb at its 'level'), and 'rite' (the Level 20 Rite, see below). PASSIVES: weapon_focus (+dmg with a chosen weapon category — the player picks which at the fork), braced_stance (-'reduce' damage taken per hit while a shield is worn). VERBS: rampage (a kill grants a free attack on an adjacent foe), guardians_stand (when an ally is about to be hit, take the blow instead — asked via Y/N). CAPSTONES: rage (timed self-buff: hit/dmg/ac/extra_attacks for 'rounds'), bulwark (allies adjacent to the hero get +'aura_ac' AC, plus a Taunt action: enemies target the hero for 'taunt_rounds'). REFINEMENTS: rampage_crits (rampage also triggers on a natural 20), stand_half_cost (guardian's stand costs only half the redirected damage). TESTING TIP: the Playtest Bench (P) banks XP and bumps playstyle counters — the fastest road to any milestone.
_rite_comment: THE LEVEL 20 RITE (doc v3). 'sigil' lists the shared 8x8x8 vocabulary — every hero draws from the same pool. Per lane, 'rite' has: 'ability' (the unique capstone verb — engine knows 'whirlwind' and 'aegis'; name/numbers are CONTENT FLAGS, rename and retune freely), 'tracked' (which playstyle counter gates the title: rampageKills or standSaves), and 'tiers' — three entries, low to high: 'min' (counter needed; thresholds are proposals, doc says TBD pending playtesting) and 'title' (offered wording; the player may re-word it but keeps the tier). Tier 2 grants 'trinket' (an item id); tier 3 also records the lane's vignette-dungeon unlock (the dungeon itself is a later build).

lanes.name: Way of the Blade
lanes.blurb: The best shield is a fallen enemy. Hit harder, guard less.

verb.name: Rampage
verb.blurb: Felling a foe grants an immediate free attack on another foe in reach.

capstone.name: Rage
capstone.blurb: Forsake defense for fury: +2 hit and damage, one extra attack, -2 AC.

refinement.blurb: Rampage now also triggers on a natural 20, not only on a kill.

ability.name: Whirlwind
ability.blurb: One furious action: strike every foe in reach, each once. Stacks with Rage.

lanes.name: Way of the Shield
lanes.blurb: The line holds because you hold it. Guard more, hit lighter.

verb.name: Guardian's Stand
verb.blurb: When an ally is about to take a hit, step in and take it yourself.

capstone.name: Bulwark
capstone.blurb: Allies beside you gain +1 AC, and you can Taunt enemies into striking you.

refinement.blurb: Guardian's Stand now costs you only half the damage you turn aside.

ability.name: Aegis
ability.blurb: Once per battle: for one full round, every blow that lands on any ally strikes you instead — at half force.
